MUSSLOP.Title: musslop desk
MUSSLOP.NoTracks: No tracks yet. Export a track from musslop with “Files → Foundry VTT (zip)” and import it here.
MUSSLOP.ImportZipHint: Pick a *_foundry.zip exported by musslop. Files are uploaded to Data/musslop/<track>/.
MUSSLOP.Pick: pick a scene or a part
MUSSLOP.GMOnly: Only the GM controls the music.
MUSSLOP.Setting.VolumeHint: Local volume for musslop playback. The GM's cue timing is shared; volume is per player.
MUSSLOP.Setting.TailsHint: Let the previous section ring out ~1 s over the new one (uses *_tail.wav if present).
MUSSLOP.PacksHint: Ready-made tracks (Creative Commons) — install with one click
MUSSLOP.PacksIntro: Free, properly licensed tracks already cut into loops with musslop. Installing downloads one track to Data/musslop/ on this server; players need nothing. Credit the artists in your game notes (CC-BY).
MUSSLOP.Setting.PackSourcesHint: Additional pack index URLs (one per line or space-separated). The official index is always included.
MUSSLOP.ClickToHear: musslop: click anywhere in Foundry to hear the music.
